tests.test_name: owner autosave persists bounded incomplete text and refuses cross-account writes
tests.keep_because: Another account cannot overwrite a private draft; a rejected write leaves the stored draft intact.

tests.test_name: a key outside the configured set signs nothing
tests.keep_because: Tokens signed by an untrusted key cannot establish identity; this exercises the shared verifier with actual disposable signing keys.

tests.test_name: COMPLETE_PAIR_REQUIRED: a half, blank, duplicated or unverifiable pair is refused before a write
tests.keep_because: Incomplete, swapped, mismatched or invalid authentication evidence is refused without changing account evidence.

tests.test_name: CSRF is required for both session creation and deletion
tests.keep_because: A cross-site request cannot create or delete the browser session without CSRF protection.

tests.test_name: EXACT_AMOUNTS_AND_PRICES: only exact eighteen-decimal amounts and positive prices review
tests.keep_because: Malformed, nonpositive or over-precision amounts/prices cannot enter a bid review, and a long amount is read exactly, never rounded.

tests.test_name: exact maximum is floored to the pinned zero-based grid without decimal rounding
tests.keep_because: Tick alignment never rounds a bid above the requested maximum; encoded calldata carries the aligned integer.

tests.test_name: tick boundaries, clearing floor, cap and huge precision use exact integer bounds
tests.keep_because: Price floors, caps, tick boundaries and integer overflow are enforced without floating-point arithmetic.

tests.test_name: BOUND_REGENT_CURRENCY: an auction raising anything else can neither be read nor bid on
tests.keep_because: A bid cannot silently spend a currency other than the configured REGENT currency.

tests.test_name: ACTIVE_WALLET_IS_THE_SIGNER: an unlinked wallet exposes nothing and prepares nothing
tests.keep_because: An unlinked wallet cannot expose a private bid position or prepare a bid.

tests.test_name: TREASURY_DRIFT_ENDS_EVERY_NEW_REVIEW
tests.keep_because: A treasury whose security changed since it was verified gets no new bid review.

tests.test_name: a receipt above the safe head stays pending rather than becoming an answer
tests.keep_because: A transaction above the safe chain head is not prematurely reported as settled.

tests.test_name: a receipt in a block that is no longer canonical stays pending
tests.keep_because: A receipt from a reorganized-out block cannot settle a launch.

tests.test_name: a canonical revert is terminal reverted
tests.keep_because: A reverted on-chain transaction is never reported as a successful launch.

tests.test_name: an approval event for a different amount or spender is unverified
tests.keep_because: An approval for a different amount or spender cannot authorize the reviewed sequence.

tests.test_name: an absent, duplicated or foreign-emitter event is never a launch
tests.keep_because: Missing, duplicate or foreign-contract events cannot count as launch evidence.

tests.test_name: an event naming another signer, treasury or raise is unverified
tests.keep_because: A launch event for another signer, treasury or raise amount cannot confirm this review.

tests.test_name: a verified local launch and bid project once under exact deterministic identities
tests.keep_because: Processing the same verified local launch/bid twice does not create duplicate records. This checks duplicate rows, not every possible replay effect.

tests.test_name: out-of-order position receipts cannot rewind claimed or graduated chain state
tests.keep_because: Late position receipts cannot turn a claimed bid or graduated auction back into an earlier state.

tests.test_name: a later invalid resource refuses and rolls the whole launch projection back
tests.keep_because: A failed multi-record launch projection rolls back instead of leaving partial financial records.

tests.test_name: hands the wallet the exact reviewed bytes from the reviewed signer and reports the hash once
tests.keep_because: A press sends exactly the step the server built, from the reviewed signer, with the chain read last, and reports its hash once against its own review.

tests.test_name: two presses in a row both reach the wallet while the first is still there
tests.keep_because: Two presses in a row both reach the wallet; nothing blocks, queues or merges a repeat press.

tests.test_name: sends nothing from a wallet other than the reviewed signer
tests.keep_because: A wallet other than the reviewed signer sends nothing, whether Privy or the wallet itself names the other account.

tests.test_name: sends nothing while the wallet is on another chain
tests.keep_because: Nothing is sent on the wrong chain, including a chain change after the switch.

tests.test_name: sends nothing when Privy changes the active wallet part-way
tests.keep_because: A press whose active wallet changes part-way sends nothing from either wallet.

tests.test_name: reports a declined request and a step the review does not have
tests.keep_because: A declined request and a step the review lacks are reported, with nothing else sent.

tests.test_name: LONG_STORED_PRICE: a bid estimate reads the whole stored price, never zero
tests.keep_because: A stored clearing price longer than 34 digits is read whole, so a bid below it is never estimated as buying now (live finding, 13 Oct 2026).

tests.test_name: HTML pages reject JSON selected by Accept or _format
tests.keep_because: JSON-selected HTML pages must return406 instead of crashing while encoding a LiveView safe-HTML tuple.

tests.test_name: a browser or an Accept header with an HTML fallback still gets LiveView HTML
tests.keep_because: Correcting JSON admission must keep HTML rendering and mixed Accept fallback working.

tests.test_name: the existing session fetch still returns JSON
tests.keep_because: JSON page rejection must preserve the existing wildcard and explicit-JSON session response.

tests.test_name: JSON account-link requests retain CSRF protection
tests.keep_because: X linking must admit its existing JSON format while continuing to reject requests without CSRF proof.

tests.test_name: SIGN_IN_ENDS_30_DAYS_AFTER_IT_WAS_MADE: a refresh never extends a sign-in
tests.keep_because: A sign-in ends 30 days after the bind that made it, however recently it was refreshed (Sean, 15 Oct 2026, decision 2a). A manual check cannot wait 30 days; the case fails if the bind stops recording the sign-in, if a refresh moves it, or if the end is counted from the last refresh again.

tests.test_name: LONG_POOL_PRICES_ARE_CUT_NOT_PARSED
tests.keep_because: Real pool prices run past Decimal's 34-digit parsing limit and may end in an ellipsis; parsing one crashed every token page with a pool price in review (Sentinel, 16 Oct 2026), and short test prices miss it. The case fails if copied details parse a price again or cut it differently from the page.

tests.test_name: hands wallet_sendCalls exactly the reviewed calls, atomically, after the chain read
tests.keep_because: BATCH_SENDS_ONLY_THE_REVIEW_ATOMICALLY: one Claim rewards press sends settle, every collect and claimAll together; the wallet must get exactly the server's calls, in order, from the reviewed signer, with atomicity required and the chain read last. A lab without a batching wallet cannot show this.

tests.test_name: sends nothing when the wallet cannot send the calls atomically, and says so
tests.keep_because: BATCH_SENDS_ONLY_THE_REVIEW_ATOMICALLY: a wallet that cannot send the calls atomically must send none of them, and the page must go back to one step at a time, where each press shows what it sends.

tests.test_name: BATCH_IS_THE_REVIEWS_ONLY_WITH_EVERY_CALL
tests.keep_because: A batch's transaction goes to the sender's own address or the entry point, never to the reviewed contract, so the usual target and calldata check cannot apply. The page says Claimed only for a transaction carrying every reviewed call in order for the reviewed signer whose receipt holds the launch splitter's own Claimed record for the signer, and for a smart account only when the canonical EntryPoint itself records success; the case fails if a log from another contract, or a successful transaction with no claim record, is ever accepted. No lab wallet sends batches, so manual review cannot reach this.
